leads.detail: UCSF neuroscientists received $8.5 million in ARPA-H funding to launch CANOPY, a global study tracking 3,000 real-world psychedelic journeys using wearable sensors and brain imaging.
leads.why_relevant: The project directly integrates brain imaging and wearable biosignal data collection for neuroscientific monitoring, highly relevant to biosignal-ML and neuroengineering students.

leads.detail: Oura agreed to acquire clinical AI startup Counsel Health for $625 million to combine continuous wearable biometrics with on-demand clinical AI care.
leads.why_relevant: As a market leader in biometric smart rings, Oura represents prime industry work in wearable sensor integration and physiological signal machine learning.

leads.detail: Czech medtech startup Kardi Ai raised €5.3 million to advance its predictive heart monitoring platform.
leads.why_relevant: Involves applying predictive machine learning algorithms to cardiac biosignals for continuous physiological monitoring and diagnostics.

leads.detail: Virtuoso Surgical obtained FDA clearance for its robotic system designed for minimally invasive, single-piece bladder tumor resection.
leads.why_relevant: Provides exposure to surgical robotics instrumentation, medical device control systems, and translational medtech regulatory pipelines.

leads.detail: Getinge announced the hiring of Stacy Beske from Philips to take over as president of acute care therapies starting December 1.
leads.why_relevant: Signals executive leadership expansion at a major medical technology provider developing acute therapeutic and monitoring hardware.

leads.detail: Rosti acquired Alvi to expand and strengthen its contract manufacturing operations for medical devices.
leads.why_relevant: Offers industry perspective on the hardware scaling, fabrication, and manufacturing phases of biomedical and wearable device engineering.
